preconditions.description: The number of rows n is between 1 and 200 inclusive.
The number of columns m is between 1 and 200 inclusive.
The number of chips k is between 1 and 200 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= sx_i <= n for sx_i in sx)
preconditions.description: Each starting row position sx_i is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= sy_i <= m for sy_i in sy)
preconditions.description: Each starting column position sy_i is between 1 and m inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= fx_i <= n for fx_i in fx)
preconditions.description: Each target row position fx_i is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= fy_i <= m for fy_i in fy)
preconditions.description: Each target column position fy_i is between 1 and m inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (len(operations) <= 2 * n * m and all(operations[i] in ['L', 'R', 'D', 'U'] for i in range(len(operations))))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 indicating impossibility, or a sequence of operations not exceeding 2nm actions, each being one of 'L', 'R', 'D', 'U'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or all(can_reach(sx[i], sy[i], fx[i], fy[i], operations) for i in range(k))
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, each chip can reach its target position at least once with the given sequence of operations.
